shell.help:
Session
  \l                         available environments
  \x                         toggle expanded view
  \timing                    show or hide timings
  \history [text | clear]    history (also \s); Ctrl+R searches backwards
  !n  /  !!                  load command n from history / the latest
  \context [json | -]        view, set or clear session context
  \clear                     clear screen (Ctrl+L)
Queries
  search <model> [-d domain] [-f fields] [-l limit] [-o offset] [--order order]
  count <model> [-d domain]
  read <model> <ids> [-f fields | -f *]
  name <model> <text> [-l limit]
  read_group <model> <groupby> [-d domain] [-f aggregates] [-l limit] [--order order]
  ref <module.name>          resolve an XML ID
  metadata <model> <ids>     creator, last update and XML ID
  \d <model> [filter] [--names name,email]  field metadata
  \dm [filter]               models
  \next  /  \prev            next / previous page of the last search
  $_                         ids of the last result, e.g. write res.partner $_ {'active': False}
  \set [name [-]]            save $_ as $name (no name lists them; - forgets it)
Results
  \grep <text>               keep the rows of the last table containing the text
  \cols a,b  /  \cols -a,b   keep columns in that order / hide them
  \alias [name <command> | name -]  save a command; `name args` runs it with args appended
User
  whoami                     current user and companies
  cam <model>                read/write/create/unlink rights
  uhg <module.group>         does the user have the group?
Writes (require confirmation)
  create <model> <values>
  write <model> <ids> <values>
  unlink <model> <ids>
  call <model> <method> [args] [kwargs]

Domains and values in JSON or Python: [('name','ilike','ada')]  {'name': 'Ada', 'active': True}
IDs: 1,2,3 or [1,2,3]. History with ↑/↓, autocomplete with Tab, → accepts the grey suggestion, new line with Shift+Enter.
Ctrl+↑ enters the last table (arrows move, Enter opens, C copies, Esc returns).
Ctrl+F searches the output; Ctrl +/−/0 changes the font size.
Ctrl+C stops waiting for a call. Click an id or relation to open it, or a long value to see it in full.
